name: Harry Stebbings
person: Harry Stebbings, British founder of 20VC (The Twenty Minute VC) podcast and venture fund, started the podcast as a teenager in 2015, grew it into a ~$400M fund. NOT any other Harry Stebbings.

enumPrompts.label: ensaios-talks
enumPrompts.prompt:
Enumerate PRIMARY content from {{PERSON}} beyond what's already known (Talks at GS Goldman Sachs talk, ~10 X/LinkedIn posts on investing lessons, the Aleph "Invested" interview, The Gentleman's Journal interview).
1. Walk his X (@HarryStebbings) and LinkedIn posts for more first-person investing-lesson threads not yet cited, he posts frequently about specific portfolio mistakes/wins with numbers.
2. Look for any solo 20VC episodes (not guest interviews) where HE is the one being interviewed by a co-host, or year-end/reflection episodes where he talks about his own fund's performance and philosophy directly.
3. Find any essay, blog post, or long-form written piece he's authored (not just social posts) about how he evaluates founders, pricing rounds, or building 20VC itself into a fund.
Return exact URLs, priority=high for anything with substantial first-person content, one-line "why" per item.

enumPrompts.label: entrevistas-recentes
enumPrompts.prompt:
Enumerate INTERVIEW/PODCAST appearances of {{PERSON}} beyond the ones already known (Aleph "Invested" E9, The Gentleman's Journal, Talks at GS, TechCrunch on the $400M fund close, a Deciphr 20VC-format episode).
1. Any 2024-2026 interview/podcast where he's the GUEST (not host) being interviewed about his own career, starting 20VC at 19 with no money/network, being underestimated for his age/British accent in Silicon Valley, the transition from podcaster to fund manager.
2. Any interview specifically about how he evaluates AI-era founders/deals differently from the SaaS era that built his reputation, his own framework for AI investing.
3. Any interview or profile about the internal culture/operations of 20VC as a fund now (not just the podcast), how he built an investment team, LP relationships, the "make Europe great again" fund thesis.
Return exact URLs, priority-marked, 8-12 items with transcripts preferred.

enumPrompts.label: criticas
enumPrompts.prompt:
Enumerate CRITIQUES and adversarial material on {{PERSON}} beyond what's already known (the Peter Walker/Carta reply on 2021-market comparisons, the ElevenLabs "biggest investing mistake" self-critique).
1. Critiques of 20VC's podcast-to-fund model itself, is being a media personality a conflict of interest for deal access/pricing? Any named VC peer or LP critique of "podcaster-turned-investor" fund managers generally, applied to him specifically.
2. Critiques of specific 20VC fund investments or missed opportunities, any portfolio company blowup, down-round, or public miss with his name attached as an investor.
3. Critiques of his public commentary style, bold market calls (froth, valuations) that didn't age well, or pushback from other investors on his takes (the Peter Walker exchange is one; find more).
Return exact URLs, type=critique, 5-8 items, be honest if adversarial material is thin (media-personality investors get less direct confrontation than operators/founders).
